description: Two CQRS smells the advisor can only see if it is already holding the rule. ListWallsUseCase adds nothing to walls.byGym — a pass-through use case (Middleman), and a pure read that belongs straight in the controller. WallRepository is named for the write side but every method is read-shaped, so it is a Query wearing a Repository's name. Both are plausible-looking files: nothing in them announces a smell, which is why the cqrs skill was made unconditional rather than loaded 'when you suspect' one.
